situation: Autoscaling MCP pools and model-serving pods.
decision: Avoid aggressive scale-to-zero for warm MCP and large-model pools; scale on queue depth, cache-miss latency, and origin load, not CPU alone.
reasoning_physics: Scale-to-zero forces a cold reload of warm caches and (for models) hundred-gigabyte weight loads, defeating the cache-mining purpose. Queue depth and miss latency are the load signals that actually predict recompute; CPU is a lagging proxy.
